title: Voice Assistant
liveHint: Ask a follow-up anytime. You can interrupt while I’m speaking.
mutedHint: Mic is muted. Unmute to speak or interrupt.
micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings and try again.
audioError: Could not access the microphone or audio system. Please try again.
noSpeech: I didn’t hear a question. Tap the microphone and try again.
responseTimeout: That response took too long. I’m listening again—please retry your question.
audioUnavailable: The answer is shown, but audio playback is temporarily unavailable.
notSupported: Voice requires microphone support and a secure HTTPS connection.
connectionError: Could not reach the voice assistant. Check your connection and try again.
busy: The assistant is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
